params.name: idx
params.let: 0 if (sx == 1 and sy == 1) else (1 if (sx == -1 and sy == 1) else (2 if sx == -1 else 3))

stem: The point $({=x}, {=y})$ belongs to $\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}$, drawn on a perpendicular graphical net. The quadrants are numbered anticlockwise starting from the quadrant where both coordinates are positive. In which quadrant does the point lie?
solution: Look at the signs of the coordinates: the x-coordinate is {=x} and the y-coordinate is {=y}.
The first quadrant has x > 0, y > 0; the second has x < 0, y > 0; the third has x < 0, y < 0; the fourth has x > 0, y < 0.
So the point $({=x}, {=y})$ lies in the {=names[idx]} quadrant.
notes: Both coordinates are nonzero so the point is always inside a quadrant. Quadrant numbering stated in stem.
